s: The drake has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the drake's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.
If the drake surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage from the attack.
{@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage.

Azbara is a 6th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). Azbara has the following spells prepared from the wizard spell list:
Azbara has two {@item spell scroll (1st level)||scrolls} of {@spell mage armor}.
When Azbara casts an evocation Cantrips and misses, or the target succeeds on its saving throw, the target still takes half the cantrip's damage but suffers no other effect.

When Azbara casts an evocation spell that affects other creatures that he can see, he can choose a number of them equal to 1+the spell's level to succeed on their saving throws against the spell. Those creatures take no damage if they would normally take half damage from the spell.
{@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

Action Surge (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
On his turn, Othelstan can take one additional action.
When Othelstan takes damage that reduces him to 0 hit points, he immediately regains 20 hit points. If he has 20 hit points or fewer at the end of his next turn, he dies.
Othelstan attacks twice with his flail or spear, or makes two ranged attacks with his spears.
{@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.
{@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.

The dragonclaw has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. While the dragonclaw can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonclaw ignores the effects of being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.
Once per turn, if the dragonclaw makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, it deals an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.
The dragonclaw has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonclaw's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.
The dragonclaw attacks twice with its scimitar.
{@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

The dragonwing has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. While the dragonwing can see a dragon or higher-ranking Cult of the Dragon cultist friendly to it, the dragonwing ignores the effects of being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.
Once per turn, if the dragonwing makes a weapon attack with advantage on the attack roll and hits, the target takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage.
The dragonwing can use a bonus action to gain a flying speed of 30 feet until the end of its turn.
The dragonwing has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dragonwing's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition incapacitated}.
The dragonwing attacks twice with its scimitar.
{@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) damage of the type to which the cultist has resistance.

Dralmorrer is a 7th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). Dralmorrer has the following spells prepared from the wizard spell list:
Dralmorrer has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put him to sleep.
When Dralmorrer uses his action to cast a cantrip, he can also take a bonus action to make one weapon attack.
Provided his longsword is on the same plane Dralmorrer can take a bonus action to teleport it to his hand.
Dralmorrer attacks twice, either with his longsword or dagger.
{@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage.
{@atk mw,rw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) piercing damage.

Jamna has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against magic.
Jamna attacks twice with her shortswords.

On his turn, Langdedrosa can take one additional action.
Langdedrosa's weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
Langdedrosa attacks twice, either with his greatsword or spear.
{@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

Langdedrosa breathes lightning in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Pharblex is a 6th-level spellcaster that uses Wisdom as his spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks). Pharblex has the following spells prepared from the druid spell list:
Pharblex can breathe air and water.
Once per turn, when Pharblex hits with a melee attack, he can expend a use of this trait to deal an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) poison damage.
As part of his movement and without a running start, Pharblex can long jump up to 20 feet and high jump up to 10 feet.
Pharblex has advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.
Pharblex attacks twice. Once with his bite and once with his spear.
{@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.
{@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit. reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

Rath is an 11th-level spellcaster who uses Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks). Rath has the following spells prepared from the wizard spell list:
Rath has a {@item staff of fire}, and scrolls of {@spell dimension door}, {@spell feather fall}, and {@spell fireball}.
{@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d8}) bludgeoning damage.
Illusory Self (Recharges on a Short or Long Rest)
When a creature Rath can see makes an attack roll against him, he can interpose an illusory duplicate between the attacker and him. The attack automatically misses Rath, then the illusion dissipates.
Rezmir has the {@item Black Dragon Mask|hotdq}, {@item Hazirawn|hotdq}, and an {@item insignia of claws|hotdq}.
Rezmir can breathe air and water.
Once per turn, Rezmir can deal an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage when she hits with a weapon attack, provided Rezmir has advantage on the attack roll.
While wearing no armor and wearing the Black Dragon Mask, Rezmir adds her Charisma bonus to her AC (included).
When Rezmir is reduced to 0 hit points, her body disintegrates into a pile of ash.
If Rezmir fails a saving throw while wearing the Black Dragon Mask, she can choose to succeed instead.

{@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points for 1 minute. The target can make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this effect early on a success.
{@atk rs} {@hit 8} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) acid damage.

Rezmir breathes acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 5d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

If she is wearing the Black Dragon Mask, Rezmir can take up to two legendary actions between each of her turns, taking the actions all at once or spreading them over the round. A legendary action can be taken only at the start or end of a turn.

A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends from a point Rezmir can see within 60 feet of her and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as Rezmir maintains {@status concentration}, up to 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the area overlaps with a area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

Talis has {@item +1 scale mail} and a {@item wand of winter|hotdq}.
Talis has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put her to sleep.
Once per turn, when Talis hits with a melee attack, she can expend a use of this trait to deal an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) cold damage.
{@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or ranged 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.
The troll has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on smell.

The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.
The troll attacks five times, once with its bite and four times with its claws. If two or more claws hit the same target, the troll rends the target, dealing an extra {@damage 2d6} slashing damage.
{@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage.
{@atk mw} {@hit +7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
